proof_scope: Binary sums of exp(-4^j) give a compact perfect totally disconnected set. Prefix cylinder masses 2^-k give a Radon atom-free probability measure. Uniform logarithmic L1 control, reverse Fatou and integrated submean inequalities give its pointwise subharmonic potential. The matching-cylinder tail estimate makes that potential minus infinity at every support point and gives infinite logarithmic energy. Fubini lifts its polar example to all real dimensions at least two. Internally proved multiplier-order estimates imply trivial ideals for every real positive scale when the Lelong number vanishes. An explicit normalized Fubini--Study kernel gives a global potential on P1, with a checked infinity chart and Lelong numbers equal to atoms. The first-degree finite-locus restriction makes its non-pluripolar mass zero. No P/I preorder theory or new external theorem is imported.
